title: Cobalt-doped vanadium nitride composite carbon hollow spheres for enhanced lithium–sulfur battery performance: overcoming sulfur dissolution and the shuttle effect
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,280-289
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01208A, Paper
Jiangnan Zhang, Yanshuang Meng, Fuliang Zhu
Co-doped vanadium nitride, used as an electrocatalyst, was synthesized through a unique preparation process to improve its dispersibility in C-HS, thereby better mitigating sulfur dissolution and shuttle effects in lithium–sulfur batteries.
